Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the sync earlier — the execs at ScanTerra want an explicit mutual action plan and a clear target go-live window before we route the SOW to procurement. High level asks from our side: a) milestone dates (kickoff, data ingestion, integration test, UAT, go-live), b) named owners for each milestone, and c) any SOW/contract timeline constraints (procurement needs 10 business days after receiving SOW).

Target we discussed on the call: aiming for production in late November but that depends on how quickly we can get integration testing scheduled. Can you put together a short MAP and a proposed timeline this week so I can share with the rest of the team?

Thanks — Kara
Kara Williams
Head of Platform Integrations | ScanTerra

> - Go-live: Nov 29 (target)

Thanks Ben — I captured a slightly more granular breakdown and flagged dependencies. I uploaded an editable Gantt to the Drive link above; attaching a snapshot here (onboarding_gantt_v1.xlsx).

Key changes / comments:
- Environment access (aws role + sample data): must be complete by Oct 20 — dev needs 48–72h to validate ingestion.
- Data ingestion split into two sprints: sample load (Oct 25–29) and full sync (Nov 1–5).
- Integration testing: to avoid a hard blocker, recommend we schedule a parallel smoke test on Nov 3–4 with Redwood infra team — that lets us surface schema issues earlier.
- UAT window: reserve Nov 15–19 but allow two contingency days Nov 22–23 if smoke test shows issues.

Owners (proposed):
- Project owner / coordination: Ben Carter (redwood)
- CS acceptance / UAT liaison: Marissa Cole (redwood)
- Technical lead (redwood): Karthik Iyer
- ScanTerra eng lead: Kara Williams (please nominate a single point of contact for engineering)
- Escalation lead (Redwood): Senior Solutions Eng (we'll confirm name after kickoff)

Risks: procurement delay, sample data quality, network firewall rules. Proposed mitigations in sheet.

Karthik Iyer
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- We will nominate an eng lead (Rahul Patel, rahul.p@scanterra.io) and he is available for a kickoff on Oct 20 instead of Oct 19.
